constraints.impact: O(n²) is about 10¹⁰ steps: far too slow. You need O(n). The answer is always at least one element.

constraints.meaning: Every value is positive and at most 10,000.
constraints.impact: Positive values: a bigger window never has a smaller sum, so it pays to grow. Small values: a counting array of size 10,001 replaces a hash set, which also makes a C version easy. A window with unique values sums to at most 1 + 2 + … + 10⁴ ≈ 5 × 10⁷, so int is enough.

constraints.text: A subarray is contiguous, with unique elements (statement)
constraints.meaning: The elements sit next to each other, and no value appears twice.
constraints.impact: Contiguous + a rule every window must keep (no repeats) + the best window → sliding window.

bruteForce.summary: try every start i, extend j to the right while the values stay unique, and keep the largest sum. O(n²) time, which is too slow for n = 10⁵.
